summary: FlightGear entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: FlightGear

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official build with documented scenery/aircraft/control setup

primary.why: FlightGear is a free, open-source flight simulator with ongoing aircraft, scenery, and simulator updates. The current official desktop release is the archive route, but version, aircraft, scenery package, weather, and add-ons define the captured state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official FlightGear build. Record version, OS, aircraft, airport/scenery, weather/time, control hardware, graphics settings, add-ons, and whether the run is a free-flight, training, or systems-simulation scenario.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact version, aircraft, scenery, add-ons, and control hardware.
